title: Output Dilution: Redundant but Fragile Representations in MoE Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.25231v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models appear to encode moral content as robustly as dense models, yet prove far more fragile in their encoding. In OLMoE-1B-7B, linear probes recover moral valence from nearly every expert-layer combination, with mean peak-layer accuracy above 90%. But these representations collapse under levels of activation noise that a dense model of matched size easily tolerates, with a 4.2-fold difference in robustness.   We trace this to output dilution. Because the MoE block averages across active experts before contributing to the residual stream, the feedforward signal reaching downstream layers is nearly two orders of magnitude smaller than in a dense MLP. Moral information, our interest, survives aggregation intact but at a scale trivially overwhelmed by perturbation. Routing itself remains stable under noise while the vulnerability originates entirely in the diluted aggregate.   Checkpoint trajectories confirm this

translated_title: 输出稀释：MoE模型中的冗余但脆弱表示
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25231v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：混合专家（MoE）模型在编码道德内容方面似乎与密集模型一样稳健，但其编码方式却远为脆弱。在OLMoE-1B-7B模型中，线性探针几乎能从每个专家层组合中恢复道德价值，平均峰值层准确率超过90%。然而，这些表示在激活噪声水平下会崩溃，而同尺寸的密集模型则能轻松承受这种噪声，两者鲁棒性差异达4.2倍。我们将此归因于输出稀释。由于MoE块在将贡献传递到残差流之前会平均激活专家，到达下游层的前馈信号比密集MLP中的信号小近两个数量级。我们关注的道德信息在聚合后完整保留，但其规模极易被扰动所压倒。路由本身在噪声下保持稳定，而脆弱性完全源于稀释后的聚合输出。检查点轨迹证实了这一点。
tldr: MoE模型在编码道德内容时表现稳健，但由于输出稀释导致表示脆弱，其鲁棒性远低于密集模型。
en_tdlr: MoE models encode moral content robustly but suffer from output dilution, making their representations far more fragile than dense models.
